messages:
Sofia: Hey team — after a scheduled SCIM cleanup yesterday we suddenly can't invite external collaborators or transfer the org. Console shows a 403 on the invite button and the transfer flow errors out.
Maya: Sorry to hear that, Sofia. Can you paste the exact API call you ran (or a screenshot) + the JSON error you see from the API? Also which org id?
Sofia: Org id is org_9X7b. Repro steps: removed ~120 external members via SCIM, ran full resync. Then tried from UI -> Organization -> Invite external user -> hit 403. Also tried API: 
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/orgs/org_9X7b/invitations" -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"email":"contractor@example.com","role":"member"}'
```
Response: 403 Forbidden with body: `{"error":"org_modifications_blocked","reason":"org_in_audit_state"}`
Maya: Thanks — that org_in_audit_state is interesting. Not a normal RBAC error. I'm going to escalate to eng-ops to check org metadata/flags.
Arun: I see the thread — pinging InfraBot to dump org flags for org_9X7b.
InfraBot: Internal note: org_9X7b has flag `audit_only`=true set via compliance automation at 2026-03-15T08:03:12Z. This flag prevents member invites and org transfers; API surfaces as 403 + org_modifications_blocked.
Maya: That explains it. Sofia — did you file any compliance requests or has your security team enabled an audit hold?
Sofia: Not that I'm aware of, we've asked compliance to do a SCIM purge but they didn't mention audit holds. They only deleted users and asked for resync.
Arun: Looks like the compliance automation that runs after bulk SCIM deletes flips the audit_only flag if >100 external removals are made in a 24h window. It's intended for legal review. We can remove the flag if you confirm it's safe.
Sofia: Please remove it — we need to re-invite contractors today. Also how do we avoid this automatically happening again?
Oliver: We removed `audit_only` for org_9X7b at 2026-03-16T14:12:09Z and cleared the temporary hold. I then triggered a re-sync for membership.
InfraBot: Post-action check: membership resync queued; invite endpoints should accept requests now.
Maya: Sofia — can you retry the same curl (replace token) or the UI invite and confirm?
Sofia: Retried the curl; got 201 Created and invite email sent. UI invite now shows success too. Thank you! :tada:
Maya: Great. For follow-up: Arun, can we add a clearer warning in the SCIM audit run logs + an admin notification when audit_only will be set? Sofia, we'll also send a KB article explaining the threshold and how to request a temporary bypass.
Arun: Yep, I'll file a small UX/infra ticket to add an admin banner and an optional dry-run mode for bulk deletes.
Sofia: Appreciate it. One last ask: can you add a pointer to who in compliance triggered this so we can align processes?
Maya: I'll include the compliance run ID and contact in the support ticket. Closing here once you confirm everything stable.
Sofia: Confirmed stable. Closing.
Maya: Closing the thread — please reopen if anything comes up. :white_check_mark:
